scope: Fresh owned development/auth-enabled SQLite; native UI only after explicit bound localhost go.

case_input.base: Native Load demo profile reads pinned frontend/src/lib/defaultProfile.ts; synthetic throughout. Do not edit display_name through hidden state/DOM APIs.
case_input.why_new_local_case: Saved profiles autosave. New unsaved local case has no savedProfile, so native draft restoration can be observed without accidentally persisting the draft.
case_input.no_runs: Never click Start research/retry/collect. Export observed run list must be empty.
case_input.delete: Only disposable saved A case; type exact DELETE and click native confirmation. No account/workspace/other-data deletion.
